modernMenuGate.message: The root certificate of the signature in the app package or bundle must be trusted.
modernMenuGate.cause: the local test certificate is not in LocalMachine\TrustedPeople (the uninstaller removes the certificate it created)
modernMenuGate.remedy: node tools/install/cli.mjs trust-test-certificate in an elevated shell, then run the setup file again
modernMenuGate.consequence: the app, registry, classic menu, Start shortcut and checksums install; the packaged modern-menu verb does not register

lifecycle.deferredCleanupCause: the uninstaller runs from the install root, so removal is deferred; the scheduled batch used `timeout`, which fails without a console, and the replacement uses `ping`
